query: WITH per_viewer AS ( SELECT viewer_login, COUNT(*)::int8 AS ticks FROM twitch_viewer_presence_ticks WHERE session_id = $1 GROUP BY viewer_login ) SELECT COUNT(*)::int8 AS "unique_viewers!", ROUND(AVG(ticks * 0.5)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS avg_present_min, ROUND(MAX(ticks * 0.5)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS max_present_min FROM per_viewer
